USD / INR 92.98 — PTI's provisional closing report for 27 Nov 2026, carried by The Hindu BusinessLine, PTI News and Moneycontrol, which states the rupee 'depreciated 60 paise to settle at 92.98 (provisional)' after opening at 92.44 and touching a low of 93.01; and FinBizNet's USD/INR close page for 27 Nov 2026, which records last close 92.98. Reuters, via The Economic Times, put the close at 92.99 and The Economic Times' own forex page shows 92.99 as an end-of-day average spot rate — a one-paisa difference from the same session. This page publishes the level two independent sources agree on rather than averaging the spread. Against the 92.44 recorded on this page for the previous session that is +0.54 (+0.58%); PTI measures 60 paise from its own previous close of 92.38

Gold 24K 999 ₹1,25,316 per 10 g and silver 999 ₹1,53,275 per kg — IBJA's 27 Nov 2026 AM benchmark (12:00 IST), published on ibjarates.com and reported at those exact figures by Bhavflow's IBJA benchmark page for 27 November 2026 (checked 27 Nov 2026, 13:00 IST); Malik Times independently reports the same two moves, 24K gold up ₹2,675 to ₹1,25,316 and silver up ₹5,928 to ₹1,53,275, both of which add exactly to the previous session's ₹1,22,641 and ₹1,47,347. Against that previous AM benchmark the move is +₹2,334 (+1.90%) and +₹6,342 (+4.32%). IBJA's 27 Nov PM fixing was not published at the time of this refresh, so the AM benchmark is used throughout, as on every previous day

One caution recorded for the reader's benefit: several retail rate pages quote 27 November figures of about ₹1,24,350 per 10 g for gold (Mint, New Delhi) or an indicative national rate of about ₹1,26,199 to ₹1,26,620 (Bhavflow's own model rate). Those are dealer, city or model rates, not the IBJA benchmark this page uses, and they are not used here.
